verdict.rationale: Kong, as evidenced here, is an API gateway and API management platform: proxying, routing, plugins, decK/kongctl for configuration, a Dev Portal and a Catalog. Running a request collection as an automated test suite with a pass/fail report is an API-client or testing-tool capability, so this story is a category error for a gateway. Nothing in the pack shows Kong shipping a collection runner or test-reporting feature that would make the axis apply.
